test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 24 Aug 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: 1500 people visited an exhibition on Saturday, while 1680 visited on Sunday. The percentage increase in the number of people visiting the exhibition is ______.
solution:
**Given:**

Number of people visiting on Saturday = 1500

Number of people visiting on Sunday = 1680

**Formula used:**

Percentage increase = dfrac{{Increase in number of people}}{{Number of people on Saturday}} times 100

**Calculation:**

Increase in number of people = 1680 - 1500

⇒ 180

Percentage increase = dfrac{180}{1500} times 100

⇒ dfrac{180}{1500} times 100 = dfrac{18000}{1500}

⇒ 12%

**∴ The percentage increase in the number of people visiting the exhibition is 12%.**
